The backend for Vulkan: the hosts that lend their device and their frame, the render bridge that records into it, and its textures, framebuffers, shaders and caches.
Learn: [Vulkan backend](/build/backends/vulkan/).

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`IVulkanHost`](/reference/vulkan/ivulkanhost/) | interface | What an application or an engine that renders with Vulkan lends JOID: the device, the queue, the command buffer of the frame and the target image. |
| [`IVulkanTexture`](/reference/vulkan/ivulkantexture/) | interface | A texture that the Vulkan renderer samples through an image view, owned by JOID or lent by the host. |
| [`SnapshotVulkanHost`](/reference/vulkan/snapshotvulkanhost/) | class | The Vulkan host of the snapshot tests: no surface, one offscreen target image and one frame in flight. |
| [`VulkanBackend`](/reference/vulkan/vulkanbackend/) | class | The backend for Vulkan, which records the frames of JOID into the frame of a Vulkan host and reads a GLFW window. |
| [`VulkanBorrowedTexture`](/reference/vulkan/vulkanborrowedtexture/) | class | An image of the host, by image view, that JOID samples without owning it. |
| [`VulkanBuffer`](/reference/vulkan/vulkanbuffer/) | class | A Vulkan buffer in host-visible, coherent memory, mapped for its whole life. |
| [`VulkanContext`](/reference/vulkan/vulkancontext/) | class | The device of the host seen by the Vulkan renderer, with its render passes, image and buffer creation, and one-shot submissions. |
| [`VulkanDescriptorCache`](/reference/vulkan/vulkandescriptorcache/) | class | The descriptor sets of the Vulkan renderer, one per shader, uniform buffer and set of image views. |
| [`VulkanFrameAllocator`](/reference/vulkan/vulkanframeallocator/) | class | Hands out aligned ranges of one buffer for the vertices or the uniforms of a frame, reset when the slot of the frame comes back. |
| [`VulkanFrameBuffer`](/reference/vulkan/vulkanframebuffer/) | class | An offscreen target of Vulkan with a color texture and a depth image, without stencil. |
| [`VulkanImage`](/reference/vulkan/vulkanimage/) | class | An image of the host described for JOID: its image and view handles, its size and its number of levels. |
| [`VulkanPipelineCache`](/reference/vulkan/vulkanpipelinecache/) | class | The graphics pipelines of the Vulkan renderer, one per pipeline key and kind of target. |
| [`VulkanRenderBridge`](/reference/vulkan/vulkanrenderbridge/) | class | The render bridge of Vulkan, which records each JOID frame into the command buffer of the host with the conventions of OpenGL. |
| [`VulkanShader`](/reference/vulkan/vulkanshader/) | class | A shader of Vulkan: the two stages compiled to SPIR-V, with their descriptor set layout and pipeline layout. |
| [`VulkanShaderCompiler`](/reference/vulkan/vulkanshadercompiler/) | class | Compiles a translated GLSL stage to SPIR-V with shaderc, at run time. |
| [`VulkanShaderTranslator`](/reference/vulkan/vulkanshadertranslator/) | class | Translates JOID GLSL to GLSL 4.50 for SPIR-V, with one `std140` uniform block and explicit `binding` and `location` qualifiers. |
| [`VulkanSnapshotBackend`](/reference/vulkan/vulkansnapshotbackend/) | class | The snapshot backend of Vulkan, which renders through a `SnapshotVulkanHost` into an offscreen image. |
| [`VulkanTexture`](/reference/vulkan/vulkantexture/) | class | A texture of Vulkan in device memory, uploaded through a staging buffer, with mipmaps built by linear blits. |
| [`WindowVulkanHost`](/reference/vulkan/windowvulkanhost/) | class | The Vulkan host of a GLFW window, which owns the instance, the device and a swapchain that follows the size of the window. |
